next patients' group meeting is on the 6th of May at 5pm. We established that patients can arrive a little early (say 10 minutes) to discuss individual problems/experience, so the PPG can focus clearly on shared problems.

Whether you can attend or not, please write your review, good or bad, and I will continue to bring them to the new team.

From the PPG meeting on Feb 4th...

The practice is fully staffed for doctors (now at 6, and 6 admin) but doesn't have a practice manager as they're having trouble recruiting because they will also manage the Oldham practice.

I have been assured they're wiring up a better fallback after 2 missed calls (most likely you will receive a text that asks you to ring the practice, but I have asked that a bookable slot picker be added too).

The website is now 24hr accessible for admin/repeats, but still cannot be used out of office hours to request an appointment. The doctor has concerns about people using it for 'urgent' requests in the middle of the night (when no doctor is available to receive it), I've tried to make a case for it, but if out of hours appointment-requests is a blocker for you, please come to meetings and help me argue the case.

I have also reraised when tests come back all green, but you're still sick, the practice currently close your diagnosis process until you re-engage (which you may not be told you need to do), which I intend to reraise in future.

---

From the PPG meeting on November 26th...

2 new doctors are on board, and new staff are coming soon.
Complaints about reception seem to be improving, less reliance on agency staff.
The website will be switched to 24hr accessible.

New Bank is on Bookable, which is much easier to use and is currently accessible outside of office hours (unlike PATCHS), but doesn't work for existing registered patients, and only has a limited number of slots and is only for booking an appointment.

---

From the PPG meeting on 10th of September.
The practice is moving to a new digital system on 1st of October, which 'should' solve some of the current technical issues with arranging appointments. Management say there will be some onboarding help and open/group sessions for anybody who would like to attend, and dates/times of those will be on a notice-board in the reception (or from Lynne, the operations manager) once those dates are arranged (probably a couple of evenings/saturdays depending on demand).

We have also been assurred the quality of help from reception has been better in the last month and will continue to improve. There is still no new practice manager. They are recruiting for one in a difficult market, but they are adding new administrators (from October 6th, if I understood correctly) and _should_ soon be adding extra doctors too, with a less clear timescale (presumably notice-period related).

The patient load on doctors is within the normal NHS range, so do not put off making an appointment just because you think they're busy, they have capacity and are adding more, and most of the problems seem to be steadily improving.

---

After leaving a previous 1 star review with many negative points and being frustrated with being unable to arrange an appointment, I attended the newly set-up Patient Participation Group meeting (as a new management company took over in April) on 6th August. The discussion between the team and a few patients was constructive and the new management team seem to have an understanding of the problems after we explained in some detail. I also brought these reviews to their attention, and provided a breakdown of reviews to their management in the meeting.

If you're here because you've had a negative experience, either recently or before the take-over, we've been assured they're working on it and should be moving to a new system, as well as dealing with the problems caused by specific staff. 1/5 - Extremely DisappointingService

Unfortunately, my experience at this clinic was very unpleasant. The behavior of the reception team was seriously unprofessional and disrespectful. On several occasions, they were either absent or busy with other tasks, leaving me waiting for long periods without any guidance. I was never informed that I needed to use the automated check-in system, and even if I had been informed, I would have required assistance.

When I encountered disrespectful and insulting behavior, none of the reception staff paid attention to the issue, which caused significant distress and psychological pressure. It seems that the clinic manager is not paying attention to these problems and is not hearing the voices of patients.
After sharing this review, I was surprised (and somewhat saddened) to find that several others had similar experiences at this clinic. Given how often such stories seem to come up, it might be worth taking a closer look—not just for me, but for others who may be facing similar situations.

In fact, what I’m about to describe is only one of several upsetting experiences I’ve had at this clinic—and sadly, not the last.

I am not sure whether this was racially motivated, but the way I was treated was deeply inhumane. I begged them to inform my doctor—who had been regularly renewing my weekly prescription for over a year—that I had run out of critical medication. They completely ignored me and, instead of offering help, shouted at me to leave the clinic.

At that very moment, I briefly saw my doctor through a door behind one of the senior staff members—she appeared to say something to someone at a desk and then turned back and disappeared. Still, the staff insisted she wasn’t there. When I told one of the senior team members—who seemed to be in charge or at least more experienced than the others—what I had seen, she and her colleagues pointed at me, laughed at my desperation, and mocked me while I stood there in distress.

After being kicked out of the clinic, I walked away with tears in my eyes, feeling utterly humiliated, unwanted, and hopeless. I was in a mental health crisis, and the lack of compassion pushed me to a point where I genuinely started thinking about ending my life. The pain of that moment hasn’t left me—it replays in my mind every single day. The medication that helped me cope was gone, and so was my sense of dignity.

And this wasn’t the only time I was treated poorly. I had endured other incidents of disrespect and mistreatment before, but I didn’t know who to turn to or how to raise my concerns. So I kept silent. Eventually, I found the courage to tell my doctor honestly and emotionally what had been happening—only to be removed from the GP a few days later.

No one should ever be made to feel that way in a place that is supposed to provide care.",null,[0,126]]]],[null,null,null,null,null,"https://business.google.com/local/business/7613126136782408941/customers/reviews/reply?p=CiRDaGREU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblRVTkpka3hRVW14QlJSQUIQAA%3D%3D",[null,null,null,"/local/business/7613126136782408941/customers/reviews/reply?p=CiRDaGREU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblRVTkpka3hRVW14QlJSQUIQAA%3D%3D"],"https://business.google.com/local/business/7613126136782408941/customers/reviews/deletereply?p=CiRDaGREU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblRVTkpka3hRVW14QlJSQUIQAA%3D%3D",[null,null,null,"/local/business/7613126136782408941/customers/reviews/deletereply?p=CiRDaGREU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblRVTkpka3hRVW14QlJSQUIQAA%3D%3D"],null,"https://business.google.com/local/business/7613126136782408941/customers/reviews/reply?p=CiRDaGREU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblRVTkpka3hRVW14QlJSQUIQAA%3D%3D",[null,null,null,"/local/business/7613126136782408941/customers/reviews/reply?p=CiRDaGREU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblRVTkpka3hRVW14QlJSQUIQAA%3D%3D"]],[null,null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/reviews/data=!4m8!14m7!1m6!2m5!1sChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTUNJdkxQUmxBRRAB!2m1!1s0x0:0x92c8f1a09ad74b50!3m1!1s2@1:CIHM0ogKEICAgMCIvLPRlAE%7C%7C?hl=en"],["https://www.google.com/local/content/rap/report?postId=ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTUNJdkxQUmxBRRAB&t=1&entityid=ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTUNJdkxQUmxBRRIlChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTUNJdkxQUlZBEgswY1NZMGsyb0RQURouChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTUNJdkxQUjFBRRITQ2d3SWpaMnB2d1lRa0tPcXp3TSISCQAAAAAAAAAAEVBL15qg8ciSKgswY1NZMGsyb0RQUQ&wv=1&d=286732320",null,null,"0ahUKEwis8P6ClKuTAxX2eIQGHc8dJtAQoykIBygB"],null,[null,[[1,1]]]],"0ahUKEwis8P6ClKuTAxX2eIQGHc8dJtAQ0pMFCAUoAQ"],null,"CAESY0NBRVFEQnBFUTJwRlNVRlNTWEJEWjI5QlVEZGZURUpGVVRoZlgxOWZSV2hCYlRGTFdXUTFZWEJvZEVkdU9XTk1VVUZCUVVGQlIyZHVPVEphV1VOYVgwcFRlV280V1VGRFNVRQ=="],[["Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21ONE1DMUJNVEp3Wmt0aVRUazFTSFp0V2xNMU9WRRAB",["0x0:0x92c8f1a09ad74b50",null,1754288532438916,1754288532438916,[null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/117638296724518942611/reviews?hl=en"],null,null,["Shadow
